correctness.rationale: Transient states A=(2,0),B=(2,1),C=(2,2) reduce to the exact 2-state pulse and 3-state continuous subgenerators for all ell,e,b>0, 0<q<=1, c=bq. Direct symbolic independent inversion verifies U_P(z)-U_C(z)=bq(z+e+b+ell)P(z)/[D_P(z)D_C(z)] for z>=0, with P a polynomial of strictly positive coefficients and D_P,D_C positive from nonsingular transient Markov M-matrices. Thus mean and every exponentially discounted survival improve under pulsing. At (ell,e,b,q)=(1/10,3,1,1), exact means 61/203 versus 469/1712. Independent rational uniformization at rate 8 and t=2 gives -98<W80<-97 with omitted Poisson coefficient sum <1/1000, rigorously reversing the fixed-time survival inequality. No floating point used to infer sign.
residual_risks: No stochastic dominance at all deterministic deadlines; rate match is nominal not realized successful colonizations; two patches only.

value.rationale: The minimal nontrivial dynamic-habitat model has a strict separation between two common persistence objectives: better expected/global exponential-deadline survival yet worse at a specified deterministic horizon. A fully rational counterexample guards against a false stochastic-dominance inference from valid Laplace ordering, a substantive boundary for interpreting disturbance-driven dispersal.
